risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a strong long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.068), which favours a robust combination.

Series context: trend strength 0.9992 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.068); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.435.
